rulings_in_order: Ruling: Keep the historical overlapping RSS+MLX resource gate unchanged, recording RSS/MLX/availability/swap separately — avoids silently relaxing the established policy — a model that physically fits may be conservatively blocked.

Ruling: Build and review the authored resource preflight before a new benchmark adapter — model feasibility is the indispensable dependency — if it passes, a separate plan adds overhead before quality evidence arrives.

Ruling: Allow root's pinned download after Task 1 approval while Task 2 is built, keeping all model loading after Task 2 approval — acquisition has independent ignored outputs and an approved verifier — if later runner work is blocked, the download may have been unnecessary.
